messages:
sophia: FYI got woken up twice by KV cache flap pages overnight. They look like short microbursts tied to pod churn, but still page. Can we agree on a short-term mitigation + an owner for follow-up?
rahul: saw the spikes. It's the model_serving.kv_cache.flap alert. Currently fires on any 5x jump in miss rate across the region.
liam: short-term: convert page -> warning for blips <5m, keep paging for sustained >=5m. Add a 15m suppression window keyed by fingerprint to avoid repeated wakeups.
marta: sounds reasonable. For long-term we should reduce sensitivity and add a per-instance dedupe key so retries don't multiply pages. I'll own the remediation ticket if folks agree.
rahul: proposed change (sketch):
```
alert: kv_cache_flap
expr: increase(kv_cache_miss_rate[5m]) > 5
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
suppression: 900s
```
then route short blips to severity: warning.
liam: can we also emit a metric for "flap_count" so we can graph how many suppressed events happened? helps decide if we can relax more.
sophia: good idea. Add that to the PR. Immediate owners: rahul -> update alert rules and push to staging; marta -> create remediation ticket + runbook updates; liam -> add flap_count metric and dashboard panel.
oncall-bot: Staging deploy recorded: prometheus/rules updated by rahul at 1767053500.
rahul: PR: https://git.internal/repo/prom-alerts/pull/457 includes rule change + unit test. Validation logs attached.
marta: remediation ticket created: RMD-3421 "kv-cache flap noise reduction". I've added tasks: 1) runbook language for flap vs sustained (ETA 48h) 2) dedupe key + suppression (ETA 1 week) 3) autoscaler/backpressure follow-up (ETA 2 weeks).
liam: I uploaded a quick dashboard with 6h/24h firing counts and a suppressed-events counter to the ticket.
sophia: can we roll the staging change to prod during the US-west maintenance window tomorrow 02:00 UTC? rahul?
rahul: will canary to two clusters at 02:00 UTC, monitoring for any missed genuine incidents. If green, full roll by 03:00 UTC. Posting a deploy note before.
marta: I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 10:00 PST to review the first 6h of prod behaviour and decide if thresholds need adjustment.
sophia: thanks. please tag the recurring incident pattern as model-serving/kv-cache-flap in the remediation tracker and link past incident IDs.
marta: done. I included links to incidents 1759001122 and 1760123344.
oncall-bot: Reminder: kv-cache-flap sync scheduled: 1767139200 (tomorrow) attendees: sophia, rahul, liam, marta.
liam: small follow-up: can we add a line to the oncall playbook that says "if you see single 1-2min flaps, treat as noise unless for: satisfied" to reduce unnecessary escalations? I'll draft it.
marta: added that to the runbook task.
sophia: excellent. once we validate in prod, marta to close RMD-3421 with final owners and dates.
rahul: monitoring through the night and will post any regressions here.
liam: thanks all. :thumbsup:
